title: Prime Minister extends birthday greetings to former President Shri Ram Nath Kovind
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has extended warm birthday greetings to former President Shri Ram Nath Kovind.
The Prime Minister said that Shri Kovind’s long years in public life have been marked by a steadfast commitment to the development of India, the values enshrined in the Constitution and the welfare of the people.
Shri Modi said that Shri Kovind has served the nation with passion and simplicity, due to which he is respected by people across all walks of life.
Shri Modi wrote on X;
“Warm birthday greetings to former President Shri Ram Nath Kovind Ji.
His long years in public life have been marked by a steadfast commitment to the development of India, the values enshrined in our Constitution and welfare of the people. He has served the nation with passion and simplicity due to which he is respected by people across all walks of life.
May he be blessed with wonderful health, happiness and a long life.
@ramnathkovind”
